Medicine.title: Medicine
Medicine.description: Shared community medicine record with automatic per-piece pricing and normalized brand uniqueness.

brandName.description: Display brand name of the medicine.

normalizedBrand.description: Trimmed, collapsed-whitespace lowercase brand name used for duplicate prevention.

pricePerPiece.description: Calculated price per piece (boxPrice / piecesPerBox) in BDT.

status.description: Visibility status of the community medicine record.

createdByUid.description: Firebase UID of the original contributor.

createdByName.description: Display name of the original contributor.

lastUpdatedByUid.description: Firebase UID of the latest contributor who added or updated the record.

lastUpdatedByName.description: Display name of the latest contributor.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when medicine was added.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when medicine was last updated.

MedicineUpdate.title: MedicineUpdate
MedicineUpdate.description: Immutable community submission and correction history entry linked to a medicine record.

brandName.description: Brand name at time of submission.

genericName.description: Generic name at time of submission.

companyName.description: Company name at time of submission.

category.description: Medicine category at time of submission.

pricePerPiece.description: Calculated price per piece in BDT.

actionType.description: Whether this entry added a new medicine or corrected an existing one.

changeSummary.description: Optional summary note of the submission or correction.

status.description: Visibility status of the community update.

/medicines/{medicineId}.description: Shared community medicine directory keyed deterministically by normalized brand name.

/medicine_updates/{updateId}.description: Append-only community medicine submission and correction feed.
